name: City flood map with live river data

mentions.name: City flood map with live river data
mentions.description: A map of the author's city showing live river height data with flood map overlays, contour data, and predicted overland flow, working with about 60GB of public datasets.
mentions.problem: Flooding is a regular concern in the city, but there was no great resource to know what's going on.
mentions.source_excerpt: A map of my city that shows live river height data with flood map overlays, contour data, predicted overland flow etc. flooding is a regular concern but theres no great resource to know whats going on. I have about 60gb of public datasets it works with.
mentions.author: jhogendorn
